name: Gossip
description:
Your time in Teek has taught you how to get the best gossip.

In towns and cities, you can always find someone who will share gossip about the wealthy and powerful. When you invoke this trait, roll a fate die. The GM interprets the result to determine what secret you learn. A higher result means you learn a juicier or more impactful secret.

Describe how you trade gossip.
successes:
🌞: Roll the fate die again and learn another secret.

💀: You must share a secret of your own before they will share anything with you.
